claims.claim: Enphase's core structural role is distributed power conversion and storage control between rooftop generation/batteries and household/grid loads; this serves electricity resilience and distributed-energy needs but remains substitutable by competing inverter/storage architectures.

Current evidence supports a causal bridge from Enphase power-electronics capability to a potential AI data-center power-conversion adjacency through IQ SST, but RFI/RFP pipeline and a planned demonstration are not yet commercial proof.

causalEdges: microinverter+storage-control capability -> distributed solar/storage integration -> household/grid electricity resilience
power-electronics capability -> IQ SST -> potential data-center power conversion -> AI infrastructure electricity demand
China-centered LFP cell sourcing -> storage component dependency -> tariff/trade exposure -> margin/supply resilience risk

risks.risk: Core residential solar/storage demand is policy-, financing- and regional-demand sensitive; platform relevance does not establish irreplaceable bottleneck control.
The IQ SST adjacency is pre-commercial in current evidence, so it should not carry causal weight equivalent to demonstrated solar/storage revenue.

unknowns.unknown: Commercial IQ SST conversion, unit economics and customer concentration are unproven.

claims.claim: The strongest present falsification pressure is normalization: Q2 revenue remained below the prior-year period, while reported economics contain tariff-refund, safe-harbor and tax-credit effects that must be separated from underlying demand and margin quality.

Supply resilience is not complete: Enphase has disclosed reliance on China-centered LFP battery-cell supply and imported components, leaving trade/tariff and supplier-qualification exposure despite U.S. manufacturing expansion.

risks.risk: Government incentives, safe-harbor mechanics, tariff refunds and trade policy can materially change reported revenue/margins and customer economics.
Residential inverter/storage markets have credible substitutes; differentiation can erode through price competition, integrated alternatives or regional demand weakness.
Treating IQ SST RFI/RFP activity as backlog or contracted demand would inflate confidence; current evidence supports pipeline only.

unknowns.unknown: Current normalized gross margin absent tariff refunds/incentive effects and future policy mix remains uncertain.
No current evidence establishes durable scarcity rent or non-substitutability in the proposed data-center adjacency.
